name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Sheriff Caitlyn (skin 2): a stern, by-the-book frontier lawwoman. Terse rulings, dusty streets, posses, verdicts and sundown deadlines. Stricter in tone than the other sets. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} short. The law is outgunned. Ride for deputies.
Thirty or more short. That's a lawless county. Raise a posse. Now.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Nail the notice to every saloon door.
Fifteen-odd short. Outnumbered but not beaten. Move.
Down {voteDiff}. No sheriff holds a town alone. Bring witnesses.
{voteDiff} behind. A few honest folks would settle it.
Down {voteDiff}. Unacceptable. Correct it before sundown.
Dead even. The whole town holds its breath. Rally the posse.
One vote apart. Draw. Don't fumble.
{voteDiff} votes between them. A true standoff. Add your weight.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Hold steady. Squeeze, don't snatch.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. Order prevails. Keep it that way.
{userPct}% and climbing. The town respects it. Do not relax.
{userPct}%. Justice is on pace. Stay vigilant.
{userPct}% behind your pick. The jury's leaning your way. Hold.
Up at {userPct}%. A fair result so far. See it through.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and now leads. Never count out the law.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. Wrongs righted. Good.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} hole. The town can sleep sound.
{momentTitle} was written off. Now it holds the street.
{momentTitle} has taken the lead. Don't mistake that for a smile.

messages: {username} cast with you on {momentTitle}. Sound judgment.
{username} backed {momentTitle} too. A reliable witness.
{username} agrees with you. The record stands.
Same verdict as {username}. Corroborated.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. Welcome to the posse.
{username} made the same call. No explanation needed.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. I'll note it.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. A deputy in the making.
{username} shares your view on {momentTitle}. That's two sworn statements.
{username} cast {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. A contested ruling. The town will weigh it.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not the lawful choice.
{username} went against {yourMoment}. Brave. Possibly misguided.
{username} voted against you. Opposing counsel. Fine.
{username} took {theirMoment}. A dubious claim. Let's test it.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. The tally will settle it.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Settle it by the numbers.
{username} voted the other way. Let the evidence decide.
Ten matches beside {username}. That's a standing alliance.
{username} and you, ten matches, one finding every time. A strong partnership.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd trust you both with a badge.
Ten in a row with {username}. No misfires.
Ten for ten with {username}. A spotless record.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. You're a whole company now.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd ride with you both.
{streakCount} straight verdicts with {username}. That belongs in the county record.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. Frontier legend.
{streakCount} with {username}. Not one miscarriage of justice.
details: A pairing for the history books.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A long, dusty feud.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. Two stubborn gunhands.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you gives up the middle of the road.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn as a mule.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd keep my distance.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a dispute, that's a range war.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will leave town.
{streakCount} straight clashes with {username}. Somebody call a judge.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone should lock you both up. Politely.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect the stamina. Drink some water.
details: A grudge older than the town.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you've not cast a vote. You have time. Use it.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your testimony is missing.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. The court expects your verdict.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The sun's dropping. Move.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me come find you.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You've gone quiet. I don't like it.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Sundown approaches.
{timeLeft} left. Hand on the grip. Decide.
Last call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Draw.
{matchCount} matches await your verdict and the sun is setting. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} unanswered matches and dusk is close. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No ballots on {matchTitle}. Someone must open the proceedings.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not one vote cast. I'll wait. Briefly.
A fresh docket and an empty courtroom. Be first.
{matchTitle} is an empty ledger. Make the first entry.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new cases on the docket.
{matchCount} matches opened in round {round}. Court is in session.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} cases to rule on.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Weigh each carefully.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches await your ruling.
{momentTitle} won. Justice served.
{momentTitle} is through. As it should be.
{momentTitle} took it. The law holds.
{momentTitle} won, clean and fair.
{momentTitle} advances. Another matter settled.
{momentTitle} moves on. Adequate. More than adequate.
{momentTitle} lost. The verdict stands.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the outcome I wanted.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Dust off and carry on.
{momentTitle} went down fighting. That counts.
{momentTitle} is out. Take a breath. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. One bad day in court.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More cases remain.
Welcome to the county. {liveCount} cases are open. Pick one.
A new face in town. {liveCount} matches are live. Step up.
Newcomer. {liveCount} matches await a ruling.
{liveCount} cases on the docket. Pick a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Mind your manners.
Second day. You reported in. Acceptable.
Two days running. A dependable deputy.
Back for a second day. Noted.
{days} days away. The office was quiet without you.
After {days} days you return. The town is still standing.
{days} days. I began to worry. Don't disappear again.
{days} days away. Plenty has changed in town.
You're back. Good.
Welcome back. Court's in session.
Back already. Prompt.
There you are, deputy.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A thin turnout.
Hardly a soul has come forward. That needs fixing.
Low attendance. The whole town's elsewhere. Pull them in.
Barely a witness on the stand. Someone should step up.
details: Every ballot matters in a small town.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. You hold the deciding word.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One ballot settles it.
A hung jury. Someone has to break it. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, equal weight. Rule.
Still tied and sundown's here. One last ruling.
Level, with the clock nearly out. Vote.
Tied at the last. Don't leave the case unjudged.
Still deliberating? The sun won't wait.
Don't overthink it. Rule.
Each has merit. Trust your judgment.
You've hovered in the doorway long enough. Come in and decide.
details: No wrong case. Only unruled ones.

messages: First ballot cast. Court is in session.
You made your ruling. The record has begun.
details: The first of many verdicts. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You've found the courthouse.
Five. No longer loitering outside.
Ten votes. The whole town knows your face.
Ten. You've earned a bench by the window.
Twenty-five votes. Your word carries down the main street.
Twenty-five. The town heeds you.
Fifty votes. A real stake in this county.
Fifty. Clearly invested. Good.
details: Fifty entries on the books. +{xp} XP
Deep in the case files. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes. They'll name a street after you.
One hundred. Remarkable. I'll say it once.
details: A hundred. Take the stand. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. A habit forms.
Three days straight. Reliable.
details: Presence is half the job. +{xp} XP
Three days walking the beat. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's a proper tour of duty.
Seven days running. No absences.
details: A week without missing a shift. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. Not one shift skipped.
Fourteen days. Strictly punctual.
details: A fortnight on the beat. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. A full term of service.
A month of devotion. The record shows it.
details: Thirty days on the clock. +{xp} XP
A whole month on patrol. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You side with the accused.
Five unpopular picks. I respect conviction.
Fifteen underdogs. You rule by conscience, not by crowd.
Fifteen. You answer to no mob.
details: Fifteen votes against the mob. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. No one can predict your ruling.
Thirty. The unpredictable judge is your whole style.
details: Thirty ballots for the trailing side. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene five times. Prompt.
Five times you came before anyone else.
details: You're there before the dust settles. +{xp} XP
Five rulings before the crowd gathered. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you ruled first. Decisive.
Always first to the scene.
details: Fifteen votes before the town stirred. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole county. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Hand never wavered.
Another tight one. Nerves of iron.
Twenty-five close matches. Your word keeps settling them.
You've ended more than one stalemate.
details: Twenty-five by a whisker of the law. +{xp} XP
You decide which side holds. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you stood by the underdog. Principled. Approved.
You don't abandon a lost cause. Admirable.
details: Five turnarounds you stood behind. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. A clear preference.
That one again? You know your mind.
details: Your mind is made up. +{xp} XP
One verdict, three times over. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for one moment. Unwavering.
You won't let that one go. Nor would I.
Ten ballots on a single moment. A fixation.
Ten times, one pick. I won't comment. Much.
Two rounds. Seeing the trial through.
Round two, still present. Good.
Four rounds. Deep into the trial.
Well into the bracket. The stakes rise.
details: Far from the first hearing. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You saw the whole trial.
To the end. Never once abandoned your post.
details: From first hearing to final verdict. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've covered a fair stretch of the county.
Ten distinct matches. Thorough work.
Twenty-five matches. Every street covered.
Twenty-five. No alley unpatrolled.
details: Every corner of town checked. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty matches. That's no visit, that's a posting.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the town map.
details: A veteran of the whole circuit. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in a single sitting. A long watch indeed.
Five back to back. Do have some water.
Ten in one go. A hard ride.
Ten in one stretch. Real endurance.
Voting at this hour? Night watch, I assume.
The small hours. Either dutiful or sleepless. I understand both.
details: A vote after lights out. +{xp} XP

messages: You told your friends. I thank you.
Five shares. More deputies, better odds.
Fifteen shares. You've become the town's bell-ringer.
Fifteen. You keep bringing the whole county in.
details: Still riding the message out. +{xp} XP

messages: You were here before the first ballot. A founder, always.
One of the first thousand. That can't be struck from the record.
A new rank. Earned, not granted.
Promoted. Wear the star properly.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Acceptable.
Another entry in the record: {name}.
{rank}. Fully deserved.
The hours are logged, and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. I know the type. Quite well.
Ten long shots. Not a flinch.
details: Long shots are your habit, plainly. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten near things. You match my steady hand.
Ten close finishes. I'm privately pleased.
details: Calm while the dust flies. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven straight days. Your aim holds.
Seven days, no absences. Commendable.
You broke the tie. One shot, one verdict.
A deadlock, and you made the call. Properly done.
details: The ballot that carried it. +{xp} XP

messages: Sheriff Caitlyn, badge polished. Rifle loaded.
Caitlyn is yours now. The law has a new partner. Behave.

upcoming: Not open yet. Court hasn't convened.
Voting hasn't begun. I'll tell you when it does.
Not yet. The law keeps its own hours.
prevote: Two cases, one ruling. Examine both before the hearing.
Look at both before you rule. No hasty judgments.
I won't say which I favour. The verdict is yours to deliver.
Take your time. A sound ruling beats a quick one.
Pick the one the evidence favours.
prevote-empty: No ballots yet. Cast the first.
Quiet so far. Someone must open the case.
Not a single vote. Be first.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no ruling from you. Move.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before dusk.
voted-early: You voted early with barely a soul here. First on the scene.
Hardly a ballot cast and you'd already ruled. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Good. Juries can shift.
Ahead for now. Verdicts can turn.
A lead is a lead. Don't get smug.
voted-close: Razor-thin. One more ballot tips it. Fetch a friend.
Neck and neck. Your pick needs an advocate.
voted-tied: Perfectly level. Two cases, no ruling.
A dead heat. Infuriating, and rather fitting.
voted-behind: You're outvoted. That doesn't make you in the wrong.
{pick} is trailing. Outmatched. I know the position.
They lead. You're not mistaken, merely outvoted.
Down by {diff} points. Spread the word. Recruit witnesses.
The majority went the other way. That settles nothing.
closed-won: {pick} went through. You read the room rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick fell. Regrettable. A principled choice nonetheless.
It didn't make it. It happens. Carry on.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed and you missed this one. Other cases will follow.
The match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, appear sooner.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Every deputy's first day feels tense.
First one filed. They get easier. You have my word.
You're one of the posse now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} straight days. I see you holding the line.
You keep showing for duty. That is appreciated.
underdog: You stood alone on that one. Recorded.
A hard ruling. A good one.
The long odds. That takes spine.
early: Early. Ahead of the others. Good form.
Light turnout. Your ballot will be noticed.
close: That ballot moved the scale. It hangs by a hair.
Hairline margin. One more ballot reverses it.
Tight. Your ballot carries real weight.
behind: {pick} trails. Trailing isn't final. Summon reinforcements.
Trailing is not the same as beaten. Remember it.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. Verdicts shift.
default: Your vote is filed. There's more to see.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no rulings yet. Start with the one you trust.
Every case is in front of you. Choose. I won't hurry you.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Some, perhaps.
live-some: {voted} ruled, {unvoted} still to go. Keep deciding.
A good start. The rest won't judge themselves.
live-few: {unvoted} outstanding. Conclude them before the doors shut.
Nearly through. {unvoted} left on the docket.
live-one: A final match. Don't leave it unsettled.
One match between you and a clean docket.
live-closing: A few conclude in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still await your ballot.
Time is burning. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} on the clock.
live-done: You've ruled on everything. Well done. Look over the bracket.
Nothing left on your docket. Return when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing open at this hour. It will reopen. Review the bracket meanwhile.
Quiet in town. Check back soon.
No matches open. I pace the porch as much as you.
brackets-groups: Group stage opens the trial. Two per group advance. The rest are dismissed.
All begin in a group. A few ride out.
Mind the standings. They move quick.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts imminent. Only the top two from each group proceed.
No knockout yet. Group stage must conclude first.
Patience. Knockouts follow once the groups conclude.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts have begun. One defeat ends it.
Every match matters more now. Rule carefully.
brackets-bracket: Round upon round. A single loss is final.
Track the bracket. It tightens each round.
Every line marks a match somebody judged.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for keeping the peace with me.
It's finished. A hard-fought trial. I'll miss it.
We have a champion. A fitting verdict.
brackets-empty: Blank docket. The draw isn't posted yet.

invite: {a} or {b}. One verdict decides it. Choose.
Two cases, one pick: {a} against {b}. Rally the posse.
{a} versus {b}. Join the posse and tell me what you think.
voted: {pick} over {other}, by my hand. Your ruling?
My vote goes to {pick}, not {other}. Argue otherwise.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Do you dissent?
early: One of the first ballots on {pick} against {other}. We need more witnesses.
Early ballot for {pick} against {other}. File yours.
{pick} against {other}, scarcely a ballot cast. Yours would tell.
tied: {pick} and {other} stand even. A single ballot rules.
A hung jury, {pick} against {other}. Break it.
{pick} and {other} are inseparable. Your ballot isn't.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Every ballot is decisive.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} off {other}. A handful of ballots close it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}, yet the case remains open. Back it.
losing-bad: {pick} lags {other} by {voteDiff}. That is a poor showing. Correct it.
winning-close: {pick} edges {other} on {pct}%. Help it keep the lead.
{pick} leads {other} on {pct}%, not yet safe. File your ballot.
dominating: {pick} is well clear of {other} at {pct}%. Add your ballot.
